Class Pivot

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.SmartPositionalMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.Pivot
Direct Known Subclasses:
Pivot, Pivot
public class Pivot extends SmartPositionalMechanism
Pivot mechanism.

A Pivot is a single-jointed rotation mechanism that rotates around the vertical axis, such as a shooter hood or turret. This core class holds pivot state, physics simulation, and measurement/predicate logic only. Command and Trigger factories live on Pivot, which extends this class and has a full usage example in its Javadoc.
